body: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
plain_description: **Fine-tune large language models for your organization’s needs.** Use a command line or web interface to train, evaluate, and run models. Supports more than 100 language and vision-language models.
technical_description: LLaMA-Factory is a framework for pre-training and fine-tuning 100+ LLMs and VLMs. It supports full, freeze, LoRA, QLoRA, OFT, and QOFT training, plus reward modeling and preference optimization methods including PPO, DPO, KTO, ORPO, and SimPO. It provides CLI and Gradio web UI workflows, inference through vLLM or SGLang, and an OpenAI-style API. Quantized training options include 2–8-bit QLoRA.
title: LLaMA-Factory
